task_description: Add a real backend (Node + TypeScript + Fastify + PostgreSQL) as the system of record for the hello-talk messenger, exposing REST commands/queries plus WebSocket real-time updates with HttpOnly session-cookie auth, reusing the existing pure domain logic (gift state machine, selectors) rather than reimplementing it, and enforcing all authorization/idempotency server-side. Then implement a frontend ApiRepository that satisfies the existing synchronous Repository interface (in-memory mirror hydrated from the server and kept live via WebSocket) and wire it in for production while keeping the 61 existing frontend tests green. Verify the real cross-session flow (create user, add friend, direct chat, messaging with read state, gift lifecycle) end-to-end and document run/test instructions. Do not commit the .kiro/ directory.

verification.summary: Frontend: 79 tests pass (61 existing unchanged + 18 new ApiRepository), npm run build and typecheck clean. Backend: 54 tests pass against a real PostgreSQL 15 booted as a child of the test process over a unix socket, typecheck and build clean. E2E script (server/scripts/e2e.ts) passes 52 assertions driving two real sessions through the live Fastify app + real WebSocket + real Postgres (create users, add friend directional, idempotent direct chat, message + read-state via WS, gift accept/extend/authorization-rejection/FORCE_EXPIRE-rejection/idempotency). Test quality reviewed: backend tests hit the real HTTP API with real session cookies and assert state read back from the DB; they verify authorization (session is sole actor identity, body actorId ignored), read scoping (a non-party sees no other user's messages/gifts), refund ledger routing to payer, FORCE_EXPIRE rejection with no state change, and idempotency incl. concurrent retries (one order/one gift message) — all would fail if the server logic were reverted. docker_build skipped: no project Dockerfile; DB runs via native child process (docker run refused by sandbox, docker compose plugin unavailable).
verification.semantic_review: Three passes. v1 NEEDS_CHANGES (7 issues: passwordless login, global snapshot, no CORS, insecure cookie, idempotency race, ghost chat id, snapshot-only reconciliation). v2 confirmed all 7 resolved but found 1 regression (empty demo login picker in server mode after snapshot scoping). v3 APPROVED with 0 issues after the picker fix. Review artifacts: 2026-09-16-032543-review.md (v1), 2026-09-16-034300-review.md (v2), 2026-09-16-035027-review.md (v3).
